This card has no contract judgement in it — text, figures, and one pin tightening — and finding one is the dev's stop condition, not something the exemption lets it resolve.

**What the dev was told not to inherit.** The card's figures (47 declared, 41 unread) are the previous review pass's readings, and the brief requires them **re-taken with the pin file's own `namedListViewMemberCount()` regex** — the instrument the assertion uses, so any other count is a different measurement and must not be quoted beside it. A disagreement with 47 is a `needs_decision`, not a number to write down: the card's premise would then be wrong and that is the seat's to re-rule. Same for the read set: the claim that `data` reaches the renderer through an `as any` cast is to be verified as a cast, with the line number treated as a pointer rather than the fact.

**And the pin must be seen to fail.** Perturbing `NamedListView` by one member has to turn the new exact assertion red with the message that names the three files whose figures move together, then restore to a clean tree. A pin written to match a number nobody has watched reject a different number is a transcription.

Premise re-verified on `origin/main` `5b5a5c3a3` before dispatch: all six wrong-figure occurrences and the loose floor are present at the four sites the card lists, with a non-zero control.

**ACCEPT — PR https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/7969, head `27bb40b2a`.** Seat reading 2026-09-06T05:10Z.

**The figures were re-taken, not inherited — which is the whole point of this card.** The dev reimplemented the pin's own `namedListViewMemberCount()` byte for byte (slice from `export interface NamedListView {` to the closing brace, count the start-of-line-plus-exactly-two-spaces regex) and ran it at its own base `d4864f3a4` **and again after merging `main` at `859de84a0`**: **47** both times, with the loose any-indent count at **59**. The read set comes off `namedViewReads()`, six of the seven read keys are declared members, and the seventh is verified as a cast rather than as a line number — `ObjectView.tsx:1815` reads `data: (currentNamedViewConfig as any)?.data ?? (activeView as any)?.data ?? (schema as any).data`. **41** follows. Independent agreement with the card, from a separate instrument.

**The pin now fails, and fails saying the right thing.** Mutation proved on disk by blob hash (`9d3a05b45c…` → `aa032c87e3…`) with the regex count moving 47 → 48; the assertion then reads:

> `NamedListView's top-level member count moved (was 47). Re-derive it with this file's own namedListViewMemberCount() regex, then update the '47 declared / 41 unread' figures in the three files that carry them together: … plus this file's own header. A shrink toward the read set also re-opens the listViews decision (objectui#7928).: expected 48 to be 47`

That is a failure message that tells the next person where to go instead of telling them a number. Restore proven by state: blob back to the HEAD hash, `git diff HEAD` byte-empty, status clean, pins green.

**Narrowing declared and measured, not asserted.** The only published source file in the diff is `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`, and its change is confined to a JSDoc block — proved by stripping comments and collapsing whitespace on base vs head: code-only characters **30654 / 30654, identical**, while raw bytes differ. `Clause-②` stands at **no** on that measurement, so no contract-review gate applies and none was manufactured.

### The three open questions

**1 — item 4's premise was wrong, and it is mine.** The card told the dev to drop the stale line range `objectql.ts:1957-2134` "where it appears". It appears nowhere: `git grep` returns exit 1 at both relevant refs *with a positive control returning hits on the same refs*. That range lived in **#7928's body**, which I had already corrected at 04:00Z — I then wrote the instruction into this card as if it were still in the tree. **Answer: A**, vacuously satisfied, nothing dropped because nothing was there, and no line range introduced. Recorded as the fourth instance this shift of the same failure mode: *an assertion carried from one artifact to another without being re-derived against the thing it describes.* The dev catching it with a controlled grep instead of quietly doing nothing is the right shape.

**2 — the changeset guard genuinely refuses an in-place correction. Answer: A, keep both.** `check-changeset-presence.mjs` counts only **added** `.changeset/*.md` files (`git diff --filter=A`), so correcting the existing changeset in place leaves the gate at exit 1 with "0 changeset(s) added". The dev corrected it in place anyway — that file is the one artifact that becomes uncorrectable once a release consumes it, which is this card's entire deadline — and added `.changeset/7947-named-list-view-figures.md` with **empty frontmatter**, the gate's own documented "this releases nothing" form. B would abandon the card's purpose; C would be a gate change riding a text-and-figures card, and the gate's behaviour here is deliberate and documented in its own header. `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` classifies this as its case 2, "you are CORRECTING a declaration on purpose", with both its "declared at base" and "declares now" lines reading `@object-ui/types: minor` — no third party's declaration was overwritten.

**3 — PR body placeholder. Answer: A, leave it.** The read-back shows the stored body complete; the sanitizer acts at write time, so the only way that fragment can now be eaten is a future PATCH, which would also downgrade the session-URL footer. An unnecessary rewrite of an intact body is the more expensive error.

### Landing — held deliberately, and this is the handoff

PR #7969 stays **DRAFT and unqueued**. It shares `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts` with PR https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/7932 at a separated region (this PR: the header and the `:537` count assertion; #7932: `REGISTRATION_TEXT` at `:113`–`:117`), and #7932 is **in the merge queue now**, third behind #7960 and #7961. The lane's third substitute discipline is explicit: merge `origin/main` again once the sibling lands and re-run the gates on that head.

I am ending this shift, so I am not enqueueing it. Sending a PR into the queue whose declared discipline calls for a post-sibling re-merge, and then leaving with nobody to attend a kick-out, is the shape that produces an unattended red. The next step is mechanical and stated here so it needs no reconstruction: **once #7932 is on `origin/main`, merge it into this branch, re-run the three pins plus `packages/types/`, then ready + auto-merge SQUASH.** ⛔ `REGISTRATION_TEXT` is not this PR's to touch in that merge — take #7932's side of it.

## 为什么定 **p2** —— 因为它带一个**会到期**的窗口

⭐ 卡片自己给了这个理由，本席认为它是决定性的：

> `.changeset/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md` is **still unconsumed**. Once the next `@object-ui/types` release consumes it into a published CHANGELOG, **the wrong figure is permanent in release history and can only be footnoted, not corrected.** Everything else here stays fixable indefinitely.

⇒ **四个站点里有三个可以永远修；第四个有一个发布窗口。** 本席核实该 changeset **确实仍未被消费**（它还在 `.changeset/` 下）。⇒ **p2，且它的紧迫性来自一个日期而不是一个严重度。**

⛔ 不到 p1：无运行期后果、无用户可见故障；错的是四处散文里的两个数字。
⛔ 不降 p3：**发布窗口一旦关闭，代价从「改四处文本」变成「永久错误 + 一条脚注」**。

## ⭐ 而那条 pin 的失效方式，值得单独记名

> That floor was chosen against the wrong count: **at a true 47 it permits the declaration to shed seven members** — including a shrink toward the read set, **which is precisely the condition that would re-open the `listViews` decision (#7928)** — without failing. **It also cannot catch growth**, so the quoted figures can stale silently in either direction.

⇒ 这是本 lane 一整天在追的那个失败类的又一变体：**一条按错误基准设的下限**，使它对**它自己声明要守护的那个条件**（声明收缩到读集）**结构性失明**。⭐ 而失败消息 `'NamedListView shrank to (near) its read set — re-take the listViews decision'` **一字不差地写着它要守的东西**——它只是守不住。

⇒ 交付物里的第 2 项（`toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(40)` → 精确 `toBe(47)`，且失败消息点名那三个必须同步移动的文件）**是本卡最持久的一半**，⛔ 比改数字更重要。
